lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Hello, Commander!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: At long last,

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: the treasure map is in my hands!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: If I can unravel its secrets,

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: we'll be able to find the treasure!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Just gotta have a little more patience.
No problem.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Good, good!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Here's a little something for the oh-so-honest Commander.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: You'll find it near the derelict city.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: There should be a collapsed bridge.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: I believe that's where you'll find it.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Then again, this is all guesswork.
How do you know all this?

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: it just so happens

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: I've been to all these places.
Every single one?

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Every last one.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: I spilled a lot of blood, sweat, and tears there.

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: I'll tell you that much!

lines.speaker: treasurehunter
lines.text: Take care now!
